references.name: north-front-2021.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary 2021 north-front photograph. Warm pale stone monumental facade; two central square clock towers with black clock faces, three-tier orange/gold Chinese hip roofs and finials; larger recessed glazed central bays with heavy rounded columns, curved upper cornice and green/gold eaves. Long low wings have large recessed vertical glazing with curved tops, small upper windows and ornamental eaves; small corner roof pavilions sit at the far ends. Temporary red forecourt shelters, flags, signs, lettering, people and branding remain separate. Exact hidden rear openings and roof inventory are unverified.

references.name: platform-canopy-2021.jpg
references.observed: Inspected train-approach photograph. It shows an independent urban rail viaduct and surrounding skyline, not the station platform canopy. Do not use it as canopy-shape evidence.

references.name: platform-canopy-2025.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary published2025 platform photograph. Open longitudinal rail/sky slots separate long shallow canopy wings. The canopy underside is ivory with gold-toned edge/ceiling bands, slender grey columns and branching steel support arms; transverse trusses and an elevated connector with stairs are visible. The picture shows only a selected platform section, not a complete module inventory. Use current PMTiles for whole bounds; preserve open spaces rather than filling a ground-to-roof station cuboid. Do not copy lettering, medallions, LED notices, people or trains.

note: Two adequate ordinary station front/canopy photographs inspected; the train-approach picture is explicitly unused for geometry. Standard PMTiles determine broad plan and true court holes. Exact hidden rear openings, canopy module/sky-slot inventory, thresholds and current works remain approximate.
